{
  "test_name": "Ledger_2297_Objection2",
  "test_code": "using System.Collections.Immutable;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\nusing Xunit;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection2\n{\n    private const string Source = @\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace TestNamespace\n{\n    [GeneratedMessagePackResolver]\n    public partial class MyCompositeResolver\n    {\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class MyObject\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int Value { get; set; }\n    }\n}\";\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task CompositeResolver_ExcludeFromCodeCoverage_RespectsNetStandard20Define()\n    {\n        var net80Refs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        var messagePackRefs = ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack);\n        var references = net80Refs.AddRange(messagePackRefs);\n\n        AssertExcludeFromCodeCoverage(references, defineNetStandard20: false, expectedPresent: true);\n        AssertExcludeFromCodeCoverage(references, defineNetStandard20: true, expectedPresent: false);\n    }\n\n    private static void AssertExcludeFromCodeCoverage(\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> references,\n        bool defineNetStandard20,\n        bool expectedPresent)\n    {\n        var parseOptions = defineNetStandard20\n            ? new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest, preprocessorSymbols: new[] { \"NETSTANDARD2_0\" })\n            : new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest);\n\n        var compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(Source, parseOptions) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(\n            new ISourceGenerator[] { new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator() },\n            parseOptions: parseOptions);\n\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out var outputCompilation, out var generatorDiagnostics);\n        var runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n\n        var compilationErrors = outputCompilation.GetDiagnostics()\n            .Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error)\n            .ToArray();\n        Assert.Empty(compilationErrors);\n\n        var resolverSymbol = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"TestNamespace.MyCompositeResolver\");\n        Assert.NotNull(resolverSymbol);\n        Assert.Contains(resolverSymbol!.AllInterfaces, i => i.ToDisplayString() == \"MessagePack.IFormatterResolver\");\n\n        var formatterCacheSymbol = resolverSymbol.GetTypeMembers(\"FormatterCache\").SingleOrDefault();\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterCacheSymbol);\n\n        const string excludeAttrName = \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\";\n\n        bool resolverHasAttr = resolverSymbol.GetAttributes()\n            .Any(a => a.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == excludeAttrName);\n        bool cacheHasAttr = formatterCacheSymbol!.GetAttributes()\n            .Any(a => a.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == excludeAttrName);\n\n        Assert.Equal(expectedPresent, resolverHasAttr);\n        Assert.Equal(expectedPresent, cacheHasAttr);\n    }\n}\n"
}
